milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' is an observation/locate task requiring the player to navigate to and visually confirm the bee_nest. The bee_nest is at spawn-relative (-5, 4, -5) on the oak tree. max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk to the tree since spawn is ~8.1 blocks away (exceeds threshold). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking up toward the beehive.

Uses inventory_has because mining a dark_oak_wall_sign drops a dark_oak_sign item which ends up in the player's inventory. The sign is at spawn-relative (-4, 1, 3) mounted on an oak_fence post. Player uses the provided wooden_axe to break it efficiently.

Uses inventory_has because mining a red_mushroom block drops the red_mushroom item into inventory. The mushroom is at spawn-relative (5, 0, -2) placed on podzol at (5, -1, -2) which prevents light-level pop-off regardless of ambient light conditions.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an oak_button places it in the player's inventory. The valid crafting chain is: mine oak_log at (2,0,1) → craft into 4 oak_planks → craft 1 oak_plank into 1 oak_button using the provided crafting_table. Player must place the crafting table first.

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' and object='water_cauldron' because in Java 1.17+ using a water_bucket on an empty cauldron converts the block to 'water_cauldron'. The cauldron is at spawn-relative (3, 0, 5). Box is ±2 around the cauldron for tolerance.

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' and object='melon_stem' because planting melon_seeds on farmland creates a melon_stem block at the surface level. Farmland is at spawn-relative (-2 to 0, -1, 6 to 8) with water source at (-1,-1,7) for hydration. Stems appear at y=0 (one above farmland). Box generously covers the farmland area.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished_blackstone_slab with the provided wooden_pickaxe drops the slab item into inventory. The slabs are in a 3x3 area at spawn-relative (8-10, 0, 5-7). A pickaxe is required — the scene provides a wooden_pickaxe which is sufficient (no minimum tier for polished blackstone).

Uses inventory_has because mining a warped_trapdoor drops the warped_trapdoor item into inventory. Located at spawn-relative (8, 0, 4). The provided wooden_axe speeds up mining but any tool or bare hand works — warped trapdoor always drops itself.

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' and object='oak_fence' because a garden requires structural borders/fencing. Player is given 6 oak_fence blocks. One pre-existing fence post at (-4,0,3) is within the check region, so min_count=4 requires the player to place at least 3 NEW fences — ensuring meaningful construction beyond the single pre-existing post.

Uses three count_in_box_at_least rules to verify ALL dependency-chain materials were placed in the cave structure near the stone hillside at spawn-relative (7-14, -2 to 5, -10 to -3). Requires: (1) polished_blackstone_slab as flooring, (2) warped_trapdoor as entrance door, (3) oak_button as redstone mechanism. All three must be present to confirm the cave incorporates materials from all prerequisite tasks.
